headline: 9-month AI Overview study reveals 51K+ event patterns; Microsoft Conversions API docs ship

Confirmed Search Updates.what_happened: Google updates Branded Searches conversion measurement in GA4 | Google更新GA4品牌搜索转化测量逻辑
Confirmed Search Updates.why_it_matters: 品牌搜索归因规则变化可能影响organic/paid渠道边界判断，需验证转化路径报告是否仍可信
Confirmed Search Updates.evidence: Search Engine Land headline; no details on specific measurement changes in snippet
Confirmed Search Updates.evidence_detail: Google has updated how branded search conversions are measured in GA4, but the RSS snippet provides no specifics on what changed—whether this affects attribution windows, conversion modeling, or the definition of 'branded search' itself. This is a confirmed product change but requires reading the full article to assess operational impact. Previous Google measurement updates (e.g., modeled conversions for iOS 14.5+) have significantly shifted reported performance.
Confirmed Search Updates.what_to_do: check GA4 release notes | compare branded vs. non-branded conversion trends before/after Aug 19

AI Search / GEO.what_happened: 9 months of AI Overview data and 51,000+ tracked events analyzed | 9个月AI Overview数据研究：51000+事件追踪分析
AI Search / GEO.why_it_matters: 首个大规模AI Overview纵向数据集，可验证AEO策略的实际触达率与稳定性，而非依赖单次观察
AI Search / GEO.evidence: Search Engine Land article citing 51,000+ tracked events over 9 months; methodology not yet verified in source text
AI Search / GEO.evidence_detail: The headline indicates a substantial dataset spanning 9 months with 51,000+ tracked events, which would make this one of the larger public AI Overview monitoring efforts. However, the RSS snippet provides no methodology details, sample selection criteria, or whether events were tracked via rank tracking API, browser automation, or other means. The actual article content needs verification to assess whether this is controlled monitoring or aggregated client data with selection bias. Source is trade news, not peer-reviewed research.

Tools, Papers & Open Source.what_happened: Microsoft Advertising publishes Conversions API documentation | 微软广告发布Conversions API官方文档
Tools, Papers & Open Source.why_it_matters: server-side转化追踪替代像素方案，提升iOS/隐私环境下的归因准确性，直接影响付费搜索ROAS
Tools, Papers & Open Source.evidence: Microsoft Advertising official documentation release; no technical details in snippet
Tools, Papers & Open Source.evidence_detail: Microsoft has published documentation for its Conversions API, following the industry pattern established by Meta's CAPI and Google's enhanced conversions. The RSS snippet confirms documentation availability but does not indicate whether this is a new API launch or documentation for an existing beta. For SEO/SEM practitioners, this matters because server-side conversion tracking bypasses browser-level ad blockers and ITP limitations. Implementation complexity and event matching methodology remain to be verified in the actual docs.
Tools, Papers & Open Source.what_to_do: audit current Microsoft Ads conversion tracking | evaluate server-side migration for high-value conversion events
